invariants.name: residue_class_consistency
invariants.description: For each residue r modulo k, all characters at indices congruent to r modulo k must be either all '?' or all equal to the same character '0' or '1'.

invariants.name: determined_class_count_limit
invariants.description: The number of residue classes already determined to be '0' must not exceed k/2, and the number of residue classes already determined to be '1' must not exceed k/2.
